title: Idea → Connected System (Skeuomorphic Patch Panel)

scenes.title: Spark switch
scenes.purpose: The idea starts as a physical toggle that powers the panel.
visuals: Walnut-framed brushed-faceplate patch panel on a cool charcoal stage
Toggle lever flips from down to up on its pivot boss
Amber pilot lamp lights when the lever seats
OUT plug seats and its jack ring glows green

beats.development: The lever swings up from 0.12s to 0.5s, the ON lamp lights at 0.42s and the OUT plug seats at 0.52s.

scenes.title: Patching the system
scenes.purpose: Five patch cables connect the idea to LOGIC, MEMORY, NETWORK, PEOPLE and OUTPUT.
visuals: Stroked cables draw from jack to jack
A plug seats as each cable arrives
Each connected jack gets a green ring and halo
The LINKS readout counts from 0/5 to 5/5

beats.development: OUT→LOGIC and OUT→MEMORY draw, both plugs seat, and the readout reaches 2/5.
LOGIC→NETWORK, MEMORY→PEOPLE and NETWORK→OUTPUT complete the system. The readout reaches 5/5 at 1.8s and SPARE stays empty.

scenes.title: System online
scenes.purpose: Confirm the working system with a frame-wide state signal, then hold the readable panel.
visuals: Marquee bulbs chase left-to-right along the top rail, then right-to-left along the bottom rail
The full, settled panel with all labels readable

beats.development: The marquee bulbs light in a circuit around the frame and settle fully lit by about 2.57s.
Hold on the complete, connected panel.

findings: All motion settles by 2.6s, before the 2.7s target.
Each action is tied to a state change: lever → lamp, cable → plug → jack light → counter, and completion → marquee.
justifiedHolds: 2.6–3.0s: final reading hold on the completed panel.

notes: Silent preview with no audio track.

There is no authored cue sequence; the silent visual actions follow a cause→effect order adapted from the background review (stateful object, readout ticks on story beats, semantic green for success).
Source slot-machine subject, branding and wording are not copied.
